content: Drizzle ORM vs Prisma 2026: Drizzle is SQL-first, lightweight (~7kb, ~45ms cold start) and integrates naturally with Postgres Row-Level Security for multi-tenancy; Prisma is heavier (~180kb, ~320ms cold start) but offers better DX for very complex relational schemas (80+ tables) at cost of verbosity in Drizzle. For a greenfield multi-tenant app prioritizing RLS-based isolation and lean queries at scale, Drizzle is preferred; Prisma is a reasonable alternative if team prioritizes migration tooling maturity and relation ergonomics over RLS-native design.
